findings.description: can_bid now calls self.spend, which calls JsonlImpressionLog.for_day, which opens the day's JSONL file, json-parses every line, and builds the invalid-id set. eligible() calls can_bid once per campaign, so each bid request reads the same day file once per campaign. With many campaigns and a day's log that grows to hundreds of thousands of lines, this turns each bid into O(campaigns x log size) disk I/O and JSON parsing on the hot serving path, and latency rises as the day progresses. The previous implementation kept per-day spend in memory and updated it on record().
findings.suggestion: Compute spend for all campaigns in one pass per request or per day, or keep an in-memory per-day aggregate that is updated on record() and refund() and rebuilt from the log on startup.
findings.title: Every bid request re-reads and re-parses the full day's impression log for each campaign
